subject.title: improve: reduce agent startup cost from TTS imports

question: Should `openclaw/plugin-sdk/speech-settings` become the supported public contract for registry-free TTS configuration primitives?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but shipping the new subpath commits maintainers to a third-party plugin API surface that automation cannot authorize.

options.title: Accept the narrow subpath
options.body: Ship the six-purpose settings contract while preserving `speech-core` for existing runtime consumers.

options.title: Keep settings internal
options.body: Pause the PR and redesign the package boundary without publishing another SDK subpath, accepting additional internal coupling or duplication.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow subpath
recommendation.body: Ship the six-purpose settings contract while preserving `speech-core` for existing runtime consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior TTS core extraction and continued SDK-boundary work make this person the strongest available owner for the public-contract decision.
